templates.name: Texte
templates.description: Generic text overlay. position: center|top|bottom|lower-third|upper-third|left|right. animation: pop|fade|slide-up|slide-down|slide-left|slide-right|blur|scale|rotate|typewriter|none. outAnimation: fade|slide-down|slide-up|scale|blur|none. size in px for a 1080p frame.

templates.name: Titre cinétique
templates.description: Big uppercase title, letters rise one by one, accent bar and subtitle. Great intro / section title.

templates.name: Néon
templates.description: Neon sign text with flicker-on.

templates.name: Glitch
templates.description: RGB-split glitch title (tech, gaming, cyber).

templates.name: Machine à écrire
templates.description: Monospace text typed character by character with a blinking cursor. cps = characters per second.

templates.name: Mots percutants
templates.description: Each word of the text appears alone, big and punchy, one after another across the clip duration (hook text for shorts).

templates.name: Citation
templates.description: Quote card with big quotation mark and author.

params.name: quote
params.default: La créativité, c'est l'intelligence qui s'amuse.
params.label: Citation

templates.name: Chapitre
templates.description: Chapter / section title: small label, line wipe, big title.

templates.name: Liste à puces
templates.description: Title + bullet points revealed one by one. items: one per line (or separated by ;).

params.name: items
params.default:
Point numéro un
Point numéro deux
Point numéro trois
params.label: Éléments

templates.name: Lower third moderne
templates.description: Name + role banner sliding in at the bottom (introduce a speaker). side: flex-start (left) | center | flex-end (right).

templates.name: Lower third minimal
templates.description: Elegant thin-line name + role (documentary style).

templates.name: Lower third verre
templates.description: Rounded translucent pill with initials avatar, name and role.

templates.name: Bouton s'abonner
templates.description: YouTube-style subscribe button with animated cursor click and bell. Pair with the 'click' and 'ding' SFX.

templates.name: Pseudo réseau social
templates.description: Platform icon + @handle pill. platform: youtube|instagram|tiktok|x|twitch|web.

templates.name: Like · Commente · Partage
templates.description: Three popping engagement buttons (like / comment / share).

templates.name: Écran de fin
templates.description: Full-frame end screen: title, two video placeholders and a subscribe CTA (opaque background).

templates.name: Flèche + légende
templates.description: Hand-drawn arrow drawing itself toward a target point with a label. x/y = target, labelX/labelY = label position, all as fractions of the frame (0..1).

templates.name: Cercle surligneur
templates.description: Hand-drawn ellipse drawing itself around something. x/y = centre, width/height = size, fractions of the frame.

templates.name: Lieu
templates.description: Map pin dropping on a point with place name. x/y = pin tip position (fractions).

templates.name: Explosion d'emojis
templates.description: Emoji particles bursting from a point (x/y fractions). emoji: one or several emoji characters.

templates.name: Compteur
templates.description: Animated number counting from → to, with prefix/suffix and label (stats, followers, money).

templates.name: Barre de progression
templates.description: Thin bar filling over the clip duration (place it across the whole video for retention).

templates.name: Graphique barres
templates.description: Animated horizontal bar chart. data: 'Label:value, Label:value'.

templates.name: Compte à rebours
templates.description: 3-2-1 countdown with a ring (one number per equal slice of the duration). go = final word (optional).

templates.name: Confettis
templates.description: Full-frame confetti. mode: rain | cannons (from both bottom corners).

templates.name: Light leak
templates.description: Warm drifting light leaks (film look, dreamy transitions).

templates.name: Grain film
templates.description: Animated film grain overlay (put it on the top track over the whole video).

templates.name: Bandes cinéma
templates.description: Cinematic black bars animating in (ratio e.g. 2.39).

templates.name: Caméscope REC
templates.description: Vlog camcorder overlay: corners, blinking REC, running timecode.

templates.name: Flash
templates.description: Quick full-frame flash (white by default) — on a cut or impact.

templates.name: Transition formes
templates.description: Three coloured slanted shapes sweep across and fully cover the frame around the middle of the clip: place the cut between two shots at clip.start + duration/2.

templates.name: Image / logo pop
templates.description: Shows an image (src = aicut://file/<encoded path> or https URL) popping in like a sticker / photo card.

templates.name: Animation Lottie
templates.description: Plays a Lottie (.json) animation (src = aicut://file/<encoded path> or https URL). Free animations: lottiefiles.com.

templates.name: Titre minimal
templates.description: Clean title: letters fade/blur in one by one, an accent line grows, small uppercase subtitle under it. align: flex-start | center | flex-end. size in px for 1080p.

templates.name: Titre masqué
templates.description: Two lines revealed from behind a mask (slide up), the second one in the accent colour. Punchy hook / intro title.

templates.name: Titre encadré
templates.description: Title with a rectangle outline drawing itself around it, then the text fades in with a letter-spacing settle.

templates.name: Mots empilés
templates.description: Each word on its own line, sliding in alternately from the left and the right with alternating colours. Great for short punchy statements.

templates.name: Lower third ligne
templates.description: Minimal lower third (bottom-left): a vertical accent bar grows, then the name and role slide out from behind it.

templates.name: Étiquette direct
templates.description: Pill-shaped tag (bottom-left) with a pulsing dot — speaker name, LIVE, location…

templates.name: Cadre + étiquette
templates.description: Rounded rectangle drawing itself around a region of the frame, with a label tab. x/y = centre, width/height = size, all fractions of the frame (0..1).

templates.name: Projecteur
templates.description: Darkens everything except a circle to focus on a detail. x/y = centre (fractions 0..1), radius = fraction of the frame's short side, opacity = darkness of the veil.

templates.name: Flèche dessinée
templates.description: Hand-drawn curved arrow drawing itself from (fromX, fromY) to the target (x, y) — fractions of the frame — with a handwritten label at its start.

templates.name: Checklist
templates.description: Card whose items appear and get ticked one by one. items: one per line (or separated by ';'); stagger = seconds between items.

params.name: items
params.default:
Trouver une idée
Passer à l’action
Être régulier
params.label: Éléments

templates.name: Étapes
templates.description: Horizontal step progress (1 → n): the line fills and each numbered step lights up in turn over the clip. items separated by ';' or new lines.

templates.name: Carte chiffre clé
templates.description: KPI card: label, a number counting up to `value` (prefix / suffix / decimals) and a delta badge. x/y = centre in % of the frame (0..100).

templates.name: Graphique donut
templates.description: Animated donut chart with legend and percentages. data: 'Label:value, Label:value'; colors: comma-separated colours.

templates.name: Courbe
templates.description: Animated line chart drawing itself with points and values. data: 'Label:value, Label:value…'.

templates.name: Emoji géant
templates.description: Big emoji sticker popping in with an elastic bounce and a wiggle, optional caption tag under it. x/y = centre in % of the frame, size px (1080p). (For animated emoji use add_sticker.)

templates.name: Notification
templates.description: Phone-style notification banner dropping from the top with a spring, then sliding back up.

templates.name: Post réseau social
templates.description: Social-media post card (tweet-like) whose like counter counts up and pulses.

templates.name: Conversation
templates.description: Chat conversation: bubbles appear one by one (received ones show a typing indicator first). messages: one per line, prefix '<' = received (left), '>' = sent (right).

params.name: messages
params.default:
< Tu fais quoi ce soir ?
> Je monte ma vidéo 😎
< Envoie quand c’est prêt !
params.label: Messages

templates.name: Barre de recherche
templates.description: Search bar where a query types itself (web-search style). y = vertical position in % of the frame, cps = characters per second.

templates.name: Chronomètre
templates.description: Circular timer counting from `from` to `to` seconds over the clip (leave `to` empty = clip duration; from 10 to 0 = countdown). x/y = centre in % of the frame, size px (1080p).

templates.name: Lien en description
templates.description: Call-to-action pill with a pulsing arrow ('link in description', 'free trial'…). bottom = distance from the bottom in % of the frame.

templates.name: Transition cercle
templates.description: A circle grows from (x, y) until it covers the frame at mid-clip, then shrinks away: put the cut under the middle of the clip. x/y in % of the frame.

templates.name: Transition glitch
templates.description: RGB glitch bars peaking at mid-clip with a white flash — centre it on a cut.

templates.name: Brûlure de pellicule
templates.description: Warm film-burn / light flare that peaks at mid-clip (screen blend) — centre it on a cut.

templates.name: Cadre arrondi
templates.description: Rounded frame border drawing itself around the picture. thickness px (1080p), margin = % of the short side, radius px (1080p).

templates.name: Soulignement feutre
templates.description: Felt-pen scribble underline drawn at (x, y) — fractions of the frame — width = fraction of the frame width.

templates.name: Badge promo
templates.description: Starburst promo badge popping in and wobbling (discount, NEW, -50 %…). x/y = centre in % of the frame, size px (1080p).

templates.name: Onde sonore
templates.description: Animated audio-waveform bars (podcast / voice visual). y = vertical position in % of the frame, height px (1080p), bars = number of bars.
